cases.text:
## Architecture

### Architecture at a glance

Requests pass through the gateway to the service. The live service is authoritative, and the platform team owns the gateway handoff.

### Design choices and tradeoffs

| Decision | Chosen approach | Benefits | Costs and limitations | Revisit when |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Request control | Route through the gateway | One policy point | Direct service paths remain out of scope | Direct access is removed |

### Architecture guidance

- [Azure API Management documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/api-management/api-management-key-concepts) supports the gateway boundary.

## Before you start
